mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES stays depressed while TRANSIT also remains weak, weekday trip chains into shopping areas stay suppressed and RETAIL_REC will be lower over the next four weeks than over the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-weeks mean even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain below their recent averages for the full next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility relative to WORKPLACES indicates more time spent at home, which reduces discretionary shopping trips and pushes RETAIL_REC down within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL is at least 1 point above its 3-week average while WORKPLACES is at least 1 point below its 3-week average
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL exceeds its recent mean and WORKPLACES remains below its recent mean.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS rebounds from a negative weekly change to a positive one, leisure outings spill over into nearby retail visits and RETAIL_REC improves over the next month.
candidate_trigger: PARKS crosses from below 0 to above 0 week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls over the next 28 days after PARKS crosses back above zero.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains far below baseline and WORKPLACES also continues to contract, access frictions dominate and retail visits weaken further over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -30 and WORKPLACES stays below -30 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain below -30 for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in GROCERY_PHARM suggests more errand-based out-of-home activity, which can spill over into nearby retail and lift RETAIL_REC over the next one to two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve within 7 to 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM moves upward from its recent trough.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous jump in PARKS and TRANSIT captures broad discretionary mobility, and that shared upturn should translate into more retail visits over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS and TRANSIT both turn upward in the same week after at least two weeks of decline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior 4-week mean within 28 days after PARKS and TRANSIT rise together.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening regime, a continued drop in WORKPLACES is the cleanest signal that commuting demand is still being removed, so retail mobility should fall over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises within 14 days even though WORKPLACES keeps trending downward.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL declines while PARKS rises, people are shifting time out of home into outside leisure, which should support more retail foot traffic and higher RETAIL_REC over the next month.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls week-on-week while PARKS is positive for the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not outperform its last-4-weeks average within 28 days after RESIDENTIAL falls and PARKS is positive in the same week.
